validate: return get(ctx.entry.employee_extension_data, 'term_facts.social_insurance_waived', false) !== true;
return interval_minutes(get(ctx.entry, 'planned_overtime_intervals', [])) / 60 <= ctx.lookup.daily_overtime_hours;
return ctx.entry.evidence_file != null;

// 劳动法 art.50: wages are paid at least monthly, so a pay date never falls over a month after the period it pays.
return String(ctx.entry.pay_date) <= add_months(String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.to), 1);

references.title: A no-pay entry or its reversal is dated in the period that will pay it. A correction to a period already paid is a reversal entry on the same catalog item, dated in the next period to run.
